summary: BetterLife Pharma filed a Form 6-K with an attached Material Change Report covering a routine update: it contracted Nucro-Technics for a GLP toxicology study, prioritized its migraine asset BETR-001, appointed director John W. LaRocca with a 500,000-share option grant, and disclosed warrant/option exercises generating $335,000. These are ordinary operational and governance matters, not a special-situation event. No deal terms, M&A, or strategic alternatives are presented, so the filing does not qualify for a special-situations category.
